note: Language Icons adds a flag icon to each language-switch link via hook_language_switch_links_alter + the languageicons_link_content theme hook. It is config-only: all state lives in the languageicons.settings config object (placement: before|after|replace; size: WxH default 16x12; path: glob with * = langcode, default modules/contrib/languageicons/flags/*.png; show_node/show_block both true). Configure route languageicons.settings -> /admin/config/regional/language/icons (permission: core 'administer languages'). No own permissions, no Drush, no plugin types. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config object: introspection reads back placement/size; execution changes placement to 'replace' (flag only) or sets a custom icon size, verified from live config.

evals.prompt: I installed the Drupal languageicons module. Where is its settings page and which config object stores its options?
evals.expected_output: Settings are at /admin/config/regional/language/icons (route languageicons.settings, permission 'administer languages'). Options are stored in the languageicons.settings config object (placement, size, path, show_node, show_block).

evals.prompt: Using the languageicons module, how do I show ONLY the flag on each language switcher link and hide the language name text?
evals.expected_output: Set the 'placement' setting to 'replace' (Icon placement -> Replace link). The languageicons-link-content template then renders only the icon, no text. Other options are 'before' and 'after'.

evals.prompt: How does the languageicons module know which image file to show for each language, and how would I point it at my own custom flag set?
evals.expected_output: The 'path' setting is a glob where '*' is replaced by the language code (default modules/contrib/languageicons/flags/*.png). Change 'path' to your own directory pattern (e.g. sites/default/files/flags/*.png) and set 'size' (WxH) to match.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the languageicons module has a non-default icon placement configured. Inspect the live configuration and state where the flag icon is placed relative to the language link text.
evals.expected_output: The placement is 'after' (icon shown after the link text): languageicons.settings placement: after.

evals.prompt: The languageicons module on this site has been set to render icons at a non-default size. Inspect the live configuration and report the configured icon size (width x height).
evals.expected_output: The size setting is 24x18: languageicons.settings size: 24x18.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the languageicons module so the language switcher shows only the flag icon and no language name text. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: languageicons.settings placement is set to 'replace' (e.g. drush config:set languageicons.settings placement replace -y, or Icon placement -> Replace link on the settings form).

evals.prompt: Configure the languageicons module on this site so language flag icons render at 32 pixels wide by 24 pixels tall. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: languageicons.settings size is set to '32x24' (e.g. drush config:set languageicons.settings size 32x24 -y, or set Image size to 32x24 on the settings form).
